positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
● User Interface
- Built a paginated video browsing view, automatically played and paused the videos as users scroll
- Created 3D avatar editing UI using UICollectionViewCompositionalLayout, and dynamically rendered
avatar images as users choose different styles and scroll for more accessories
- Created animations to achieve smooth UI transition, and add exciting sensation to the user experience
● Networking & Databases
- Set up cloud and local databases, and designed NoSQL data schemes.
- Cached large media assets to save bandwidth
- Prefetched data and media assets to guarantee short loading time and smooth browsing
● Architecture
- Used protocols, closures, modularization, and the singleton pattern to separate concerns and
communicate between classes.
● Memory and debugging
- Fixed memory leaks issues using the memory graph tool
- Detected performance bottlenecks using the Instruments tool
- Avoided race conditions through DispatchQueue and OperationQueue
- Used the GPU debugger to fix rendering engine bugs
● GPU Graphics Rendering with the Metal API
- Built Rendering Engine using Metal, with instancing, morphing, Physical-Based-Rendering, scene graph, hit-testing using ray tracing, skeleton animation & transform.
● Video and Audio
- Built customized video recorders that recorded: (1) videos captured by cameras; (2) 3D animated scenes rendered by a Metal GPU rendering engine
- Processed and synthesized video and audio assets, e.g. merged media assets, added overlays to visual assets, synthesized animated videos, and added sound effects to audio assets in real-time
● AI/ML Models Implementation
- Implemented TensorFlow AI models, interpreted the prediction results, and integrated the result into
user-interactive features.
- Used the Accelerate Framework to process image and audio data to achieve high computational
efficiency and guaranteed real-time predictions.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · REST APIs · Technical Leadership · Machine Learning · Collaborative Problem Solving · Swift (Programming Language) · Software Design Patterns · UIKit · Reasoning Skills · Swift Package Manager · Software Development

Processed data at large scale using AWS, SparkR, Hadoop

positions.title: Sr. Analytics Scientist
positions.description:
•	Project leader: 
1.	Lead our 4 month revenue model improvement project with a team of 6, Layout project plan and foresaw some obstacles on execution; 
2.	Introduced Agile Project Management method to our team, which balance short-term feature development and achieved long term modeling solutions & modules
3.	Focus on internal client’s feedbacks, achieve highest possible quality

•	Bring in new modeling/reporting solutions: 
1.	Created feedback campaign lift forecasting model from A to Z, which had since been critical for PI sales; 
2.	Introduced Business Intelligence tools such as Qlikview, Spotfire, and Tableau, demonstrated the value to our business, which lead to a solid decision of acquiring Spotfire as our reporting dashboard tool
positions.insights: Skills: Mathematics · Machine Learning · Collaborative Problem Solving · Reasoning Skills

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Building customer behavior analysis models that can:
•	Predict each customer’s likelihood to book
•	Prioritize customers by their commitment to make a purchase
•	Identify effective/ineffective contacting strategies 
•	Activate old customers effectively and increase sales from old customers
Revenue Management Models:
•	Analyzing price elasticity of products
•	Analyzing customers behavior of utilizing discounts as well as their price sensitivity
positions.insights: Skills: Mathematics · Machine Learning · Collaborative Problem Solving · Reasoning Skills

positions.title: Advanced Analytics Consultant
positions.description:
•	Design and improve decision tree models to predict sales and  indentify sales drivers
•	Create behavioral analysis models evaluating marketing campaigns to gain customers and grow sales, which broadened our business scope and enhanced our client relationship
•	Optimize sales/income, find the optimal marketing resource deployment using simulated annealing, which achieved 10%-20% sales increase
•	Contribute business savvy questions and model solutions to help increase client satisfaction and grow client profile
•	Create client-ready deliverables, attend client meetings, and present analysis results; Design user-friendly Excel analysis tools(Macro enabled)
•	Understand clients’ ad-hoc financial/operational requirement and enhance the flexibility and practicability of the statistical models
positions.insights: Skills: Mathematics · Machine Learning · Collaborative Problem Solving · Reasoning Skills
